minutes.headline: Board of Health seat filled by unanimous joint vote; BrightFarms greenhouse got informal support; DPW director announced retirement.
minutes.summary: The Select Board met remotely and jointly with the Board of Health to appoint a member to a vacancy. It heard BrightFarms' proposal for a lettuce greenhouse and a request for support for a state grant and a tax increment financing agreement. It also heard the DPW director's retirement announcement, set a town manager evaluation timeline, and previewed upcoming agendas.

what_happened.line: The Select Board and Board of Health voted unanimously in a joint session to fill the open Board of Health seat until next year's election.
BrightFarms presented a lettuce greenhouse proposal and asked for support for a state MassWorks grant application and a tax increment financing agreement.
BrightFarms asked for interest in a tax abatement agreement for its growth period, which would need Town Meeting approval.
The town manager evaluation timeline was set, with a vote September 8; the vote on accepting the timeline was not audible in the captions.
The DPW director's retirement was announced, and the board agreed to add an agenda topic on changes the new charter will require.

why_it_matters: A tax increment financing agreement would reduce a business's property taxes for a period and requires a Town Meeting vote, so residents may be asked to decide on it.
The DPW director's retirement and the assessor hire touch road, cemetery and property assessment services, and the assessor position must be funded within the existing budget.
watch_next: BrightFarms' MassWorks application, due at the end of August, and any Town Meeting article on a tax increment financing agreement.
The town manager evaluation steps: composite presented September 1, vote September 8.
